entities.name: Devouring Deep
entities.description: Obsolete creature type for a serpent-like eel-fish of Dominaria.

entities.name: Caliphear
entities.description: Used nightmare powers to question a Devouring Deep.

entities.name: Altair
entities.description: Stopped Caliphear from torturing the Deep.

entities.name: Samite Healer
entities.description: Was going to burn a Devouring Deep at the stake.

entities.name: Merfolk Assassins
entities.description: Visage that is the Deep's darkest fear.

entities.name: Coldraith of Golthonor
entities.description: Wizard the Devouring Deep confessed to serving.

events.summary: Caliphear and Altair find a Samite Healer about to burn a Devouring Deep that was part of an attacking army; Caliphear questions it with her nightmare powers.
events.quote: Caliphear assisted with questioning the Deep using her nightmare powers

events.summary: Altair stops Caliphear's torture and the Deep confesses it served Coldraith of Golthonor.
events.quote: it confessed to serving the wizard Coldraith of Golthonor

relations.quote: it confessed to serving the wizard Coldraith of Golthonor
